rows.definition: internal/egresslist/manifest.go: renders the bundled egress filter-list artifact as a pure function of the upstream allow/block rules, carrying NO timestamp so re-refreshing an unchanged source re-renders identical bytes.
rows.distinction: Materializes a GENERATED policy FILE (deterministic, diff-stable) - NOT a report renderer that prints a live run's status to a console, and NOT the render funcs that format a scorecard pane.

rows.definition: cmd/fak/cachevalue_status_render.go: writes the cache-value status report (the observed vs billed cache-read economics summary) to an io.Writer for `fak` cache-value inspection.
rows.distinction: Renders the CACHE-VALUE status report specifically - NOT renderCompactAudit (the compaction-audit report) and NOT renderDispatchTick (the dispatch tick line).

rows.definition: cmd/fak/chatops.go: returns the static help text for the chatops command surface - the list of chat-driven verbs and their syntax.
rows.distinction: Renders a STATIC help string (no run state) - NOT the report renderers that format a live run's status, and NOT renderGuardPromotionOffers (which enumerates actionable offers).

rows.definition: internal/session/compactaudit_corpus.go: writes the compaction-audit result (which spans a compaction dropped/kept, top-N by mass) to an io.Writer.
rows.distinction: Renders the COMPACTION-AUDIT corpus result - NOT renderCachevalueStatus (cache economics) and NOT RenderRepeatReport (tool-call repeat totals).

rows.definition: cmd/fak/dispatch_tick_worker.go: formats one dispatch-tick payload map into a single human status line for the fleet dispatch loop.
rows.distinction: Renders ONE dispatch-tick line from a payload map - NOT RenderArtifact (a generated file) and NOT RenderNegframePane (a full scorecard pane).

rows.definition: internal/livecodebench/gradedarm.go: renders a graded A/B arm comparison as a Markdown table (per-arm pass rates and deltas) for a benchmark run report.
rows.distinction: Renders a GRADED A/B benchmark comparison as Markdown - NOT RenderNegframePane (a negation-tax pane) and NOT RenderCompactAudit (a compaction report).

rows.definition: cmd/fak/guard_promotions.go: writes the list of pending guard-policy promotion offers (candidate policy widenings an operator may accept) to an io.Writer and returns the count.
rows.distinction: Renders ACTIONABLE guard-promotion offers (returns a count) - NOT renderChatopsHelp (static help) and NOT renderResumeWatchdogStatus (a drain-status report).

rows.definition: internal/scorecardpane/negframe.go: renders the negation-framing (negation-tax) scorecard pane as a formatted string for the scorecard console surface.
rows.distinction: Renders the NEGATION-TAX pane - NOT RenderGradedABMarkdown (a benchmark A/B table) and NOT renderDispatchTick (a fleet tick line).

rows.definition: internal/toolproc/repeatstream.go: writes the repeated-tool-call report - the top-N repeated calls and their totals, printing counts NOT bodies - to an io.Writer.
rows.distinction: Renders TOOL-CALL REPEAT totals (counts, not bodies) - NOT RenderCompactAudit (compaction spans) and NOT renderResumeWatchdogStatus (resume drain status).

rows.definition: cmd/fak/resume_watchdog_runtime.go: writes the resume-watchdog drain status (stalled sessions the watchdog is nudging back to work) to an io.Writer.
rows.distinction: Renders the RESUME-WATCHDOG drain status - NOT renderGuardPromotionOffers (guard offers) and NOT renderDispatchTick (a dispatch tick line).

rows.definition: internal/memvaluescore/score.go: a memory-value scoring EVENT with weight x2 - a claim-verified orientation block that was actually delivered into a session (contrasted with stale_withheld x8 and lesson_distilled x4).
rows.distinction: A memory-value SCORING EVENT (was an orientation block delivered?), NOT a render FUNCTION that materializes bytes - it names an outcome the memory curator counts, not a formatter.
